notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.notes:
First, I want to thank you all for such a generous patience, I've got some serious buisness at my regular job and had no time to develop my indie games.

Achievements Fixed

unlock 10 mages changed to unlock all mages, excluding "coming soon" ones.
fixed some achievements that  were not being unlocked, even thou requirements has been filled.
Unlock All Achievements now also check for Max Mana collected.


Additionaly, music has been changed to the previous version.

Thanks for your support!

Wulo

notes.title: Update 0.5 is Live
notes.notes:
Multiplayer is still to be tested, but right now I updated the game with some patch fixes including:
-disabled debug options
-increased gems drop rate
-made mashing keyboard playstyle not working
-noticed by "WarC0zes" Achievement Bug Fixed
-proposed by "Raubensandwichthe1st" Music and Audio Sliders instead of On/Off Option.
-Added GameProgress Bar, for player who like to finish what they started.

Multiplayer will be up at the end of the Weekend!

Thanks Guys for supporting Indie Game Dev.

TheWulo
